data.body:
Operator decision (2026-11-19 PST): keep 61689bf468f5 unrevoked.

Reasons:
- The key was rotated on 2026-09-07 as part of the routine rotation sweep in auspicial-wily-warbler (899f-f964-327c-4c47). That sweep listed it among the externally anchored secrets; it was not rotated because of a compromise.
- No evidence shows the key left the production op-cert environment's control, so it still identifies that environment.
- Revoking it would only invalidate a legitimate identity.

The operator also stated that op-cert keys should not be hardcoded in the repository. That direction is tracked separately. No change to `trusted_environments.yaml` is made under this ticket.
